request: I run a small animal shelter. I need to keep a list of pets with their name and kind, see all of them, and mark a pet as adopted.
summary:
I've built the pet list app, including your new request: every pet now has a colour, and it must be given when adding a pet. All 6 of my automated checks pass. They cover adding pets, listing them, each "must be given" rule, and marking pets as adopted.

**What you can do with it:**
- **Add a pet** (`POST /pets`): give a name, kind and colour, for example Bella, dog, brown. The system gives the pet an id number and records it as not adopted. If the name, kind or colour is missing or blank, the pet is refused.
- **See all pets** (`GET /pets`): shows every pet with its id, name, kind, colour and whether it has been adopted.
- **Mark a pet as adopted** (`PATCH /pets/{id}/adopted`): picks a pet by its id number and marks it adopted. It's refused if no pet has that id, or if that pet is already marked as adopted.

**About the colour change:** the data file (`pets.db`) already existed before you asked for colour. When the app starts, it adds a colour column to that file if one is missing. Any pets stored before then will have a blank colour, and since there's no way to edit a pet yet, those can't be filled in.

**Two things you should know:**
- **Test pets are in your data file.** My checks ran against the same `pets.db` file, so it now contains test pets like Bella and Tom. Delete `pets.db` before you start using the app for real, and it will make a fresh, empty one the next time it starts.
- **Anyone can use it.** There's no sign-in, so anyone who can reach the app can see the list and add or change pets.

The questions from the plan are still open: should only staff have access, do you want to be able to fix or remove a pet, and should we record the date a pet was adopted? Let me know and I can add any of these.

plan.summary: This plan keeps a simple list of the pets at your shelter. For each pet we store its name, its kind (for example dog or cat), and whether it has been adopted yet. You will be able to add a new pet, see the whole list, and mark a pet as adopted. Nothing else is included, so there is no sign-in and no way to edit or remove a pet. A few questions for you: Should anyone be able to see or change this list, or only shelter staff? (We left out any sign-in because you did not ask for one.) Do you also want to be able to fix a typo in a pet's details or remove a pet from the list? Would it help to record the date a pet was adopted? Just tell us and we can add any of these.

data.name: Pet
fields: id: a number the system gives each pet automatically so it can be told apart from the others
name: the pet's name, for example Bella
kind: what sort of animal it is, for example dog or cat
adopted: yes or no; starts as no when the pet is added

endpoints.does: Adds a new pet to the list using the name and kind you give. The pet starts as not adopted.
Shows every pet on the list, with its name, kind, and whether it has been adopted.
Marks one pet, picked by its id number, as adopted.

rules: A new pet must have a name. If the name is missing or blank, it is refused.
A new pet must have a kind. If the kind is missing or blank, it is refused.
Marking a pet as adopted is refused if no pet has that id number.
Marking a pet as adopted is refused if that pet is already marked as adopted.
